name: Craig Gaunson
title: Counsellor (Relationship & Psychological Counselling, Hypnotherapy)
practice: Croydon Relationship & Psychological Counselling (The Lotus Rooms)
description: I can help you with Marriage Counselling, Family Counselling, All other Relationships - including same sex - Communication, Conflict Resolution, Anxiety, Depression, Stress, Phobias, PTSD, Grief/Loss, Addictive Behaviours, Self Esteem, and Anger Management. The modalities I have found to be successful are CBT, NLP, Gestalt Therapy, and Hypnotherapy. Worldwide video conferencing available.
specialties: Relationships (including same sex), PTSD, Anger management, Hypnotherapy, Couples

name: Tammie (Mornington Counselling)
title: Counsellor
description: Mornington Counselling Practice is led by Tammie, a specialist in trauma recovery, relationship issues, self esteem, personalised birthing preparation, birth trauma, co-parenting, death and dying, grief and loss. My trauma informed care and individualised approach ensures each client feels held and supported. In person sessions available in Mornington, Victoria; telehealth sessions available Australia wide.
specialties: Trauma recovery, Birth trauma, Grief and loss, Relationships, Peri-menopause, Adoption

name: Alex Panagiotopoulos
title: Clinical Director & Senior Clinical Psychologist
description: Alex is the Clinical Director of Frankston Counselling Services and has been working in private practice for 20 years, treating adults, adolescents and children with complex psychiatric presentations, substance use disorders, neurodevelopmental disorders, mood and anxiety disorders, relationship problems, P.T.S.D and gambling disorders. The practice's psychologists use approaches including EMDR for resolving traumatic significant life events.
specialties: PTSD, Substance use, ASD/ADHD, Gambling, Relationship problems

name: Armando Miotti
title: Senior & Clinical Psychologist
description: Armando is a Clinical Psychologist and Senior Psychologist with extensive experience working with adults with complex psychiatric presentations, substance use disorders, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, P.T.S.D and personality disorders.
specialties: PTSD, Personality disorders, Substance use, Mood disorders

name: Joanne Fleischer
title: General Psychologist (Telehealth Only)
description: Joanne has over 20 years' experience working in clinical settings supporting adults with mood and anxiety disorders, post traumatic stress disorder (P.T.S.D), adjustment disorders, grief and loss, workplace issues and bullying. Diploma in Clinical Hypnosis. Telehealth only.
specialties: PTSD, Grief and loss, Workplace issues, Clinical hypnosis

name: Naomi Holt
title: General Psychologist
description: (Currently on leave.) Naomi has extensive experience working with adolescents and young adults, and also works with couples and families, with people experiencing substance use disorders, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, post traumatic stress disorders and adjustment disorders.
specialties: Post traumatic stress, Adolescents, Young adults, Couples, Families
